from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib, sys
base=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4'
env=json.loads((base/'model_results'/'A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261007-R4P2.json').read_text())
checkpoint=base/env['checkpoint']
task=json.loads((checkpoint/'TASK.json').read_text())
applied=json.loads((checkpoint/'ASTRA_REVIEW_APPLIED.json').read_text())
root=Path(task['candidate_source_root'])
review_path=root/applied['review_ref']
review=json.loads(review_path.read_text())
payload=json.dumps(review,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()
sha=hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
print('ERROR_CLASS=R4P2_REVIEW_BINDING')
print('ERROR=REVIEW_REF='+applied['review_ref']+'|DECISION='+str(review.get('decision'))+'|SOURCE_TASK_ID='+str(review.get('source_task_id'))+'|CANONICAL_SHA256='+sha)
raise SystemExit(1)
